title: Scotland's 'most haunted' pub named as spooky boozer tops UK list - see top 10
excerpt: Guests have reported waking up to see the ghosts of a young family staring back at them.
content:
• Scotland Now
  • Ghosts

Guests have reported waking up to see the ghosts of a young family staring back at them.

10:15, 29 Oct 2026

A Scottish pub has been named the "most haunted" in the UK in a new study. Among the numerous ghosts that are rumoured to call the historic inn home are a crofting family and a young cattle drover, while there have also been reports of unexplained flickering lights.

‌

‌

New research conducted by VELO investigated pubs across the UK that are said to be the site of supernatural activity. More than 100 venues with reported paranormal activity were examined as part of the experts' 'Haunted Pub Index', with two Scottish pubs featured in the top 10.

‌

According to VELO, the number one most haunted pub in the UK is The Drovers Inn in the small hamlet of Inverarnan. Situated near the northern tip of Loch Lomond, the historic inn dates back to the early 18th century and brings visitors from across Scotland and beyond who are hoping to encounter a ghost.

‌

The experts state that The Drovers Inn boasts approximately 300 Google reviews that reference its unsettling atmosphere and spine-chilling reputation. One of the strangest phenomena reported at the hotel are small intense white lights that float in the air without explanation before disappearing.

‌

Meanwhile, among the ghosts that are said to roam The Drovers Inn are a young crofting family with a tragic backstory. The family are thought to have been kicked out of their home and aimed to seek refuge at the inn, but froze to death before they could reach it. Since then, there have been reports of guests waking in the middle of the night to find the family staring back at them.

‌

Another spirit said to wander The Drovers Inn is a young cattle drover named Angus, who arrived at the inn three centuries ago. According to legend, Angus tried to get revenge on a Highland chieftain who had his family murdered but the chieftain's clan got the jump on him first.

The clan reportedly hanged Angus from a tree near the inn and proceeded to bleed him like one of his cows. Ever since then, multiple guests at The Drovers Inn have claimed to hear Angus's screams of agony as he continues his eternal search for those who murdered him.

‌

The second Scottish pub featured on VELO's roundup of the most haunted boozers in the UK is The Banshee Labyrinth in Edinburgh, which places at number six on the Haunted Pub Index. There are at least four ghosts associated with the underground venue in the Scottish capital according to the experts.

‌

Claiming the number two spot on the Haunted Pub Index is The Golden Fleece in York, which is the subject of more than 230 Google reviews mentioning ghosts or paranormal activity. Completing the top three is The Ancient Ram Inn in Gloucestershire, which has received more than 130 reviews referencing its haunting atmosphere.

A spokesperson for VELO commented: "We've uncovered some of the UK's spookiest pubs, giving Brits plenty of unusual places to explore this spooky season. Life is full of moments we don't want to miss—and an evening in a spooky watering hole as we approach Halloween is certainly one of them."

‌

See below for the full list of the 10 most haunted pubs in the UK according to VELO.

The top 10 haunted pubs in the UK

  1. The Drovers Inn, Inverarnan
  2. The Golden Fleece, York
  3. The Ancient Ram Inn, Wotton-under-Edge
  4. The Skirrid Mountain Inn, Wales
  5. The Mermaid Inn, Rye
  6. The Banshee Labyrinth, Edinburgh
  7. The White Horse Inn, Pluckley
  8. The Grenadier, London
  9. The Bate Hall, Macclesfield
  10. The Red Lion, Avebury
